title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: [SAMPLE] Stark Industries Arc Controller Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Stark Industries Arc Controller contains hard-coded credentials that allow remote administrative access.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: [SAMPLE] Wayne Enterprises Cave Mail Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Wayne Enterprises Cave Mail Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows reading arbitrary files.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cyberdyne Skynet Backup contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
